title: Uniform and Bridge
author: Oscar Almeida
blurb: Sebastian Joubert, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
